content:
q30.

Four memo lifecycle events dispatch webhooks:

| Event | Dispatch function |
|---|---|
| `memos.memo.created` | `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` |
| `memos.memo.updated` | `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` |
| `memos.memo.deleted` | `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` |
| `memos.memo.comment.created` | `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` |

All four are defined in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. The first three delegate to a shared internal method `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (same file, line 48), which resolves the memo creator's webhooks and enqueues each one. `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` does its own lookup (against the *related* memo's creator) but follows the same pattern.

All four converge for delivery through **`webhook.PostAsync`** (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`), which enqueues the payload onto a buffered channel (`asyncPostQueue`). Four background goroutines (spawned in `init()`, line 42) drain that channel and call **`webhook.Post`** (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`), which performs the actual HTTP POST with optional HMAC-SHA256 signing. So the single delivery convergence point is:

**`webhook.Post`** in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` (line 120) — every webhook, regardless of lifecycle event, is ultimately delivered here.
